protocol.scope: Development-only CFO-invariant lag-product timing proposals; no capture policy change
protocol.method: Fold x[k+lag]*conj(x[k]) at exact rounded physical frame starts; subtract its mean and correlate with identically formed pilot lag products. CFO contributes a common phase, leaving correlation magnitude invariant. Lag zero is the earlier signed real power correlation.
protocol.limitations: This proposes timing and a phase-derived CFO, not verified detection. Phase-derived CFO is ambiguous modulo sample_rate/lag. No threshold or CFO correction is fitted to reference outcomes. All inputs are development data.
